rows.question: Which credit bureaus get the rent payment history?
rows.answer: RealPage currently reports rent payment history to all three major credit bureaus: Equifax, Experian and TransUnion. The specific bureaus can change without prior notice. A resident's monthly rent payments will be reported to at least one of the three major bureaus while they are subscribed. Each bureau decides on its own whether and how to use the reported rent payment information. RealPage is not a credit bureau and has no direct influence over credit profiles or scores. A resident can check their rental payment tradeline by going directly to one or more of the bureaus that receive their rent payment history.

rows.question: Can a community give residents rewards if it does not use the resident portal?
rows.answer: Possibly. The passage says that a company not using LOFT can still offer residents a loyalty program through Community Rewards, which is a standalone product. Community Rewards is designed for third-party property management companies. It gives residents points-based incentives to renew, refer and review.

rows.question: Do we automatically get proof when a resident buys renters insurance?
rows.answer: Yes. With RealPage's integrated insurance solutions, proof of coverage is handled automatically, so site teams do not need to collect or verify insurance documents by hand. The passage says this also keeps policies active and compliant throughout the lease term. RealPage tracks policy status in real time and updates compliance records automatically. Residents who are not compliant are flagged, and insurance enrollment is built into the leasing process.

rows.question: A prospect runs student housing. Is there anything for splitting utility bills between roommates?
rows.answer: Yes. SimpleBills lets students split water, electric, gas, cable and other shared utility bills among their roommates. It is offered to RealPage Utility Management (RUM) customers. SimpleBills is built for student housing. It bills each resident their portion of the utilities and sends one bill per month for all utilities. The listed features include no deposit, no setup, and no contact with utility providers. Residents get full customer support, and provider bill information is fully visible. For site staff, the passage says SimpleBills frees them from tedious billing tasks. It also says it improves payment performance across campus assets.

rows.question: How does the system handle CAM reconciliations for commercial leases?
rows.answer: RealPage manages CAM reconciliations systematically. It also manages CPI-based escalations and percentage rent. The stated aim is to reduce manual error and bill accurately according to lease agreements. CAM recoveries run through a recovery billing engine that handles the whole commercial billing recovery process. The engine manages base years, gross ups, minimums and caps, and expense exclusions, among other items. When a calculation is executed, the engine displays all missed billings. It is also described as reducing errors in recovery billbacks.
